notes.title: 📸 Small Touches, Big Improvements!
notes.content:
📸 Small Touches, Big Improvements!

Hello everyone!
We're excited to share another small but meaningful update for Photographer's Life Simulator! Your feedback continues to help shape the game and we're working hard to deliver an even more immersive and enjoyable experience.

🎨 New Demo Features:
- Wall Painting - You can now paint the walls of your shop in the demo version! Add a personal touch to your studio with different colors.
- Wood Flooring - Floor customization is now possible! Install stylish flooring to make your space truly yours.

🖥️ UI Overhaul:
- A complete user interface redesign of all computer related menus. The new layout is cleaner and more pleasing to the eye, making your workflow faster and more enjoyable.

As always, thank you for playing and sharing your feedback with us.
Be sure to check out the new features in the screenshots below!
We've also updated the images on the Steam store so you can check them out!

Happy shooting!
- The Photographer's Life Simulator Team

notes.title: Mini Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Today we're rolling out a small but meaningful update. This patch includes several bug fixes, performance improvements, and some quality-of-life enhancements to make your gameplay experience even smoother.

 Helpful Reminders:
We noticed that some players were missing or forgetting about the customer request section, which often led to poor-quality shots. To help with this, we've added a subtle reminder panel (visible in the photos below) that will appear during gameplay to keep you on track.

 New Features:
A new progression system has been added that allows players to gain experience and level up as they play. As you level up, your skills improve, adding a deeper sense of progression and mastery to the game.

 Demo Content Expanded:
We've added a cashier to the demo version who works in your store. This gives players access to more content and a better feel for store management mechanics.

Your feedback means a lot to us—don’t hesitate to share your thoughts!

Happy playing! 
– The Photographer's Life Simulator Team

notes.title: 📸 Photographer’s Life Simulator – DEMO is now available! 🎉
notes.content:
📸 Photographer’s Life Simulator – DEMO is now available! 🎉

Time to step behind the lens — the free demo of Photographer’s Life Simulator just dropped!

Run your very own photo studio: set up the perfect shot, choose your gear, work with clients, and build your business from the ground up. From studio portraits to creative themed sessions, from printing photos to delivering custom albums — it’s all in your hands.

🖼️ Try out the demo, test your eye for detail, and get a feel for what it’s like to live the photographer’s dream!

We’d love to hear your thoughts — your feedback will help shape the full game! 💬
